# Which step of the J0 start-up stalls? Each suspect runs in a subprocess with a timeout, so a hang is recorded and cannot kill this job.
using JSON3
function trial(name, cmd::Cmd; tmo = 45)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer(); t0 = time()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(`timeout $tmo $cmd`); stdout = out, stderr = err))
    so = String(take!(out)); se = String(take!(err))
    return Dict("name" => name, "exit" => p.exitcode, "timed_out" => p.exitcode == 124, "seconds" => round(time() - t0; digits = 1),
                "stdout" => so[max(1, end - 500):end], "stderr" => se[max(1, end - 600):end])
end
jl(code) = `$(Base.julia_cmd()) --startup-file=no -e $code`
function main()
    res = Dict{String,Any}("host" => gethostname(), "trials" => Any[])
    t(x) = push!(res["trials"], x)
    res["env_mpi_slurm"] = Dict(k => v for (k, v) in ENV if occursin(r"^(SLURM_(JOB_ID|NTASKS|PROCID|STEP|LOCALID|NODEID)|PMI|PMIX|OMPI_MCA|OMPI_|MPI)", k))
    res["which"] = Dict(x => something(Sys.which(x), "none") for x in ("mpirun", "mpiexec", "srun", "nvidia-smi"))
    mpi0 = "using MPI; println(MPI.versioninfo())"
    mpiinit = "using MPI; t=time(); MPI.Init(); println(\"init_s=\", round(time()-t; digits=2), \" size=\", MPI.Comm_size(MPI.COMM_WORLD)); MPI.Finalize()"
    t(trial("mpi_versioninfo (no init)", jl(mpi0)))
    t(trial("mpi_init_default", jl(mpiinit)))
    t(trial("mpi_init_ob1_vader", `env OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1 OMPI_MCA_btl=self,vader $(jl(mpiinit))`))
    unset = String[]; for k in keys(ENV); occursin(r"^(SLURM_|PMI_|PMIX_)", k) && push!(unset, k); end
    t(trial("mpi_init_without_SLURM_PMI_vars", Cmd(vcat(["env"], vcat([["-u", k] for k in unset]...), Base.julia_cmd().exec, ["--startup-file=no", "-e", mpiinit]))))
    Sys.which("mpirun") !== nothing && t(trial("mpirun_-n_1", `mpirun -n 1 $(jl(mpiinit))`))
    Sys.which("srun") !== nothing && t(trial("srun_-n_1", `srun -n 1 $(jl(mpiinit))`))
    t(trial("pkg_project_dependencies", jl("using Pkg; t=time(); d=Pkg.project().dependencies; v=Pkg.dependencies(); println(\"pkg_s=\", round(time()-t; digits=2), \" n=\", length(d))")))
    t(trial("cuda_init", jl("using CUDA; t=time(); println(CUDA.driver_version(), \" \", CUDA.name(CUDA.device()), \" s=\", round(time()-t; digits=2))")))
    t(trial("nvidia_smi_throttle", `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=clocks_throttle_reasons.active --format=csv,noheader,nounits`; tmo = 20))
    t(trial("nvidia_smi_events", `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=clocks_event_reasons.active --format=csv,noheader,nounits`; tmo = 20))
    println(JSON3.write(res))
end
main()
